direction.title: AI note-taking launch printed on a botanical specimen sheet
direction.twist: every other section inverted, end to end

spec.typography: A classic book serif for display at clamp(48px, 8vw, 120px), a plain sans for body at 18px.
spec.color: Warm amber glow on deep brown; text at 4.5 to 1 contrast or more.
spec.layout: Every other section flips to inverted color, on a 12 column grid with fluid type.

spec.texture: A soft paper grain on flat color.
spec.signature: The hero section built like a botanical specimen sheet.
spec.pattern: One specimen centred with a label in the corner, as the section divider.
steal: The print details and wear of a botanical specimen sheet.
The discipline of one rule: every other section inverted.
The candlelit color temperature.
avoid: A hero with no clear first action.
spec.whyItFits: A candlelit mood and botanical specimen sheet give the AI note-taking launch a look no competitor has.
